strategies.name: forceswing_long
strategies.description: Author's daily FORCESWING LONG scan: uptrend (close above SMA10 and SMA20), 3-bar lower-high pullback, Force Index 3-MA <=0 while 13-MA >=0, ADX(20)>30; enter on break of the setup bar's high; stop under setup low; ~7% target.

source.book: A Practical Guide to Swing Trading
source.quote: the short term battle is now won by the bears, but still the bulls are in control of the longer-term battle

decisions: Book enters with a buy stop $0.06 above the setup day's high on the next session. Approximated as: setup conditions evaluated on the previous bar ([1] offsets), entry when the current bar closes above that bar's high. This fills later/worse than a resting buy stop.

Force Index MAs are not in the grammar. Approximation: FI-3MA<=0 ~ close[1]<=close[4] (net 3-bar price change <=0) and FI-13MA>=0 ~ close[1]>=close[14] (net 13-bar change >=0). This ignores volume weighting, so it is only a rough proxy.
Stop: book uses the HIGHER of entry-4% and (prior-day low - $0.06). Grammar allows one stop type; used lowest_low(1) (= setup bar's low). The 4% cap is not enforced — see needs.
Target: book takes half at +7% with stop at most 4% below; fixed percent target not in grammar, so used 2R for the full position (with a ~3.5% stop this is ~7%).
Time stop 20 bars: book holds 'a few days to a few weeks'; 20 daily bars ~ 4 weeks. Not in the book.
ADX period 20 per the scan's 'ADX20'.
risk_pct 0.0027: book allocates 1/15 of capital per trade with a max 4% loss, i.e. ~0.27% of account at risk.
Book scans daily stock charts; mapped to 1d and 4h.
Force Index averages use Elder's EMA of (change x volume): force_index(3) <= 0 and force_index(13) >= 0 on the setup bar.
uncodable: Universe filter: price > $12 (or $7) and 20-day average volume >= 500,000 shares — stock-specific; replace with a quote-volume liquidity filter for crypto
Gap rules: gap = open >= $0.50 from prior close; wait 30 min (gap with trade) or 5 min (gap against) and use today's high/low instead of yesterday's — no gaps/market open in 24/7 crypto
Order left working for up to 5 trading days if not filled
Short side (FORCESWING SHORT / short swing): sell stop $0.06 below prior low, buy stop at lower of +4% or $0.06 above prior high, buy limit for half at -7% — not allowed (long-only spot)
Portfolio: capital split into 15 equal slices (up to 20); first 15 of ~25 triggered buy stops get filled
Not coded yet: buy_stop_entry(prior_high + offset)
Not coded yet: stop = max(entry*0.96, low[1]-offset) (tighter_of two stops)
Not coded yet: partial_take_profit(50% at +7% fixed percent)
Not coded yet: trailing_stop(prior_bar_low - offset, ratchet up only)
Not coded yet: pending_order_validity(5 bars)

strategies.name: forceswing_long_ride_the_wave
strategies.description: Same FORCESWING LONG setup, but exit managed only by a trailing stop to approximate the book's 'ride the wave' second half (stop raised daily to prior low - $0.06).
